freeze_basis: MAIN doctrine + reconciled Stage-3/Stage-9.5 plan obligations + pre-outcome audit; no Stage-10 treatment outcomes accessed.

hard_gate.prerequisite: Close Stage 9.5 legitimately, including exact checkpoint recovery/verification, valid 9.5-6 rerun, and in-order 9.5-9 with zero unresolved Class-A defects.

stage_specific_pre_outcome_freeze_requir: exact seeds and paired treatment structure
exact neural-update identity and C/D matched isolation
symbolic generation-validation separation and lifecycle semantics

master_obligations.requirement: Direct attack-pattern / conditional-label-change scenario frozen before outcomes.
Gradual drift design frozen before outcomes where scientifically defensible.
Unseen/evolving-attack design frozen before outcomes where scientifically defensible.
Second flow-oriented dataset inclusion/exclusion criteria frozen before outcomes; materially different operating context required.
Corrected-CICIDS/improved-reconstruction sensitivity frozen where useful; never counted as independent second-environment replication.
Candidate selection strengthened using independent confirmation or nested equivalent.
Prospectively test withdrawal/lifecycle authority semantics because the accepted mechanism is withdrawal-dominant.
Test a defensible alternative symbolic evidence horizon.
Retain MCSC unchanged while triangulating coverage, correctness, fidelity, conflict, stability, complexity, churn/version persistence, and temporal continuity.
Quantify 100-bootstrap gate granularity and higher-replicate sensitivity where feasible.
Alternative periodic/random-clock schedules required before any trigger-superiority claim.
Label-noise, missing-label, variable-delay, and replay/label-poisoning stress required before operational/deployment robustness claims.
Second materially different neural backbone required before architecture-invariant claims.
Label-free monitor may be added only as separately frozen diagnostic/replication; primary monitor is not retrospectively replaced.
Refresh literature adversarially before each major replication milestone and immediately before submission.
Preserve no-natural-drift-ground-truth, no real-time/deployment, no adversarial-robustness, no analyst-usefulness, and no first-ever claim boundaries unless separately evidenced.

selection_rules: Scenario/dataset choice is based on scientific compatibility and reconstructible semantics, not treatment-effect favorability.
Second-dataset inclusion/exclusion criteria are frozen before C/D outcomes.
Do not force incompatible cross-dataset feature or symbolic semantics; narrow claims instead.
Corrected/reconstructed CICIDS is a data-quality sensitivity, not an independent environment.
causal_and_reporting_rules: Paired seed is the within-scenario causal replication unit unless prospectively replaced by a justified unit.
Windows, rules, events, opportunities, and bootstrap/explanation records are not independent causal replicates.
Report every scenario/dataset separately before any pooled summary.
Any pooled summary is secondary and requires a defensible common estimand.
Five seeds in one scenario are stochastic replication, not environmental replication.
inferential_rules: No robustness/replication result may replace an inconvenient accepted primary result.
No test chosen after outcome access may be called prospectively confirmatory.
Primary n=5 is not extended after inspection to chase significance.
Trigger superiority requires separately frozen comparator-clock sensitivity.
Architecture-invariant and operational-security claims activate conditional obligations before claim use.
Null, mixed, and unfavorable replication findings are preserved and reported.
future_hostile_review_requirement: In-order Stage 9.5-9 must verify v1.1 or a later prospectively justified master protocol.
